title: Readable description and aligned specification table
summary: Improve the description typography and present saved admin details in a clearly aligned table.

changes.detail: Increase description to 14px with 25px line spacing and stronger contrast. Keep description content and translation behavior unchanged.
Use a softly outlined specification table with alternating neutral rows, 13px text, aligned label/value columns and extra width for long values. Preserve exact admin wording and order.
Refine accordion heading size, remove the filled open-chevron circle and add an explicit accessible button role.
